description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways -  Order to amend the Gazette Ex. No. 1469/38 of 03.11.2006 by substituting  items of the Faculty of Engineering, University of Moratuwa
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an official order issued under statutory authority (Section 27(1) of the Act) that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Moratuwa. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending existing legislation and regulations governing university structure, rather than constituting a government personnel appointment or organizational restructuring.
